title: Activate one Math Discovery protocol RED chain and independently observe unbound CLR metadata drift
commitMessage: test: begin Math Discovery protocol RED binding consistency

contribution.summary: Start the ready M8 protocol RED hierarchy and record two newly falsifiable CLR signature/metadata alignment gaps.
contribution.value: Transition exactly M8, M8-W01, M8-W01-C01, M8-W01-C01-T1 and its RED leaf from ready to in-progress using typed, target-reentrant DWF transitions. Add a Math-owned .NET 11 probe that runs the unchanged historical portable verifier and pinned thirteen-case corpus in an isolated copy while adding three new controlled inputs: parameter-type drift and binding-member drift must be observed admitted (RED gaps), and metadata-granted authorization must remain refused (control). Retain all canonical historical source and package identities and no completed achievements.
debtChanges: RS285 succeeded first-pass and prepared the one M8 protocol RED leaf, but no native work was active and no new RED falsification had yet been observed.

The existing portable verifier checks the SHA-256 of its canonicalSignature but does not bind the declared parameter type or binding member to that signature; new controlled probes characterize both gaps.
The original pinned verifier and its thirteen fixtures remain unchanged; M8 GREEN/Verification, other M8 branches, M9, product backlog, published packages and broker authority are not advanced.
contribution.nextAction: Build an independent strict Math-owned binding-metadata admission gate in a later GREEN run, showing both drift cases refused while matching metadata and runtime-only authorization remain accepted.
